what: @mfe/shared-contracts 1.0.1 merged to main (PR #1): SHARED_CONFIG.billingUrl is now https://homelab.local/billing/v2 (same name, new value). Lib lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build time, so no registry publish and no npm install/lockfile change is needed. Merging the lib alone deployed no app (CD only detects changes under apps/core-shell and apps/sub-route-billing).
who: dev-b: rebuild/ship core-shell and reports so they pick up the inlined 1.0.1 value; each app needs a commit under its own apps/ dir (e.g. bump its package.json version) for CD to rebuild it. Note CD change detection may not cover sub-route-reports. dev-a is shipping billing.
